text:
Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastGames(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
∀x (SummerOlympicGames(x) → SportingEvent(x)) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastGames(tokyoGames) ∧ Location(tokyoGames, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyoGames) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬(LastGames(x) ∧ Location(x, tokyo)) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
